summary: Today's briefing highlights significant legal rulings and developments in the retail sector, indicating a mixed day for legal and business affairs.

bullets.text: Sameer Chugh appointed General Counsel of Diageo India, enhancing the company's legal leadership.
Bengaluru court sets aside ₹9 crore arbitral award against Karnataka Education Department, impacting state finances.
Delhi High Court warns Chief Secretary of contempt for failing to implement open prisons, stressing accountability.
Tata Consumer Products reports strong growth in India business for Q2, signaling robust market performance.
PepsiCo India launches new snacks line aimed at boosting festive season sales, targeting consumer preferences.
